comment: She is an incredible professor and gives each student the chance to earn an A. If you read the textbook chapters and participate, you will easily learn the content. She is super clear about assignments and grading. Amazing professor.

Very knowledgeable, engaging lectures, many readings. Two written exams, but they're fairly straightforward if you pay attention in class. Easy to access for office hours. Loved this class & professor!

Chen was the best, she is so understanding and loves her students. She knows her stuff and will always help you out of class. There are NO exams, which makes sense for a poly sci class. Do well on the papers and make sure you PARTICIPATE. Take her she's awesome!

Dr. Chen was a great professor. This class is lecture-heavy and you need to participate for your participation grade, but she grades very easy on essays. She also is very accessible outside of class and gives great feedback.

One of the best profs! Her teaching style was helpful, featuring lectures, group work, and case studies. I found it easy to get good grades on the essays as long as I put in decent effort, and she gives good feedback. She values participation, I would speak once every class and still got a B for it. Otherwise, super caring and knowledgeable prof.

Dr. Chen is extremely knowledgeable. Going to her office hours is valuable. This was a good introductory course to comparative politics. The only thing I didn't like about this course is that Dr. Chen grades a bit arbitrarily (the rubrics can be vague), but she provides good feedback for improvement.

Prof. Chen is amazing! She's very knowledgeable about the subject matter and explains the concepts in a way that makes sense. If you attend class, do the reading, and ask questions as needed, this class is not hard. She's extremely helpful outside of class, and is not at all a harsh grader. If you're going to take PLSC 240, take it with her!

Dr. Chen is incredibly caring and really wants you to do well in her class. She will give you very helpful feedback on any assignments (mainly two short papers and one longer research paper), so take advantage of that and don't start right before the due date! Classes are mostly lectures, but she is very knowledgeable and great to listen to!

Dr. Chen is incredibly knowledgeable about poli sci and her lectures were great. The overall grade is mostly based on participation and a couple papers, so you definitely can't get by without putting in some effort. Doing homework is a must because she cold calls on 3 people at the start of every class to explain the readings for that day.

I loved Dr. Chen's class on comparative politics. Lectures were always interesting and included a wide variety of topics, countries and discussions. The final paper might be a bit hard, but overall I found the essay prompts to be engaging and very interesting. Would 100% take this professor for a future class!! SHE'S GREAT!

Lecture heavy & boring class but super nice professor. No need to study as each exam is take home. Nor do you really need to do any of the homework as she calls upon 3 different people each class to discuss what you found to be interesting from the HW (easy to make up on spot). A couple essays, 1 midterm and 1 final- all easy to BS.

Very cool person, cool background. Love the current events we talk about in class, but the entire hour and fifteen minutes of class is solely boring, white slides. Didnt do any reading whole semester and will have a high B or low A. Spent most of time in class on my computer...pretty easy class, but not fun and not a breeze by any means

Dr. Chen is a really nice professor, although the class is a bit boring. She tries to incorporate current events into our learning which is pretty interesting. Not as easy of a grader as one would think, but gives good feedback. Lots of people skipped class because most of the time all you need was to read the textbook however participation matters

Dr. Chen is an amazing prof. She is incredibly intelligent and knowledgeable about almost everything in the realm of current events or political science. She is very organized, and respectful towards her students, allowing students to determine their own grading rubrics. Her class allows for participation but the lectures are focused and clear.

Dr. Chen is super kind and cares a lot about her students. She wants everyone to be successful. Her expectations are clear and she even lets the students come up with certain course policies at the beginning of the semester. Her lectures are very interesting and contain current events to understand concepts in action. I recommend her to everyone.

Take her class. She has daily readings and cold calls on 3 students in the beginning of class to share one thing you learned from the reading, but you can easily bs the readings and get away with not really doing them. Only had 3 papers, midterm and finals are very manageable. Not that much work, and she is extremely nice and a fair grader.
Great perspectives and a fair grader!
Take Dr. Chen! So knowledgeable and kind! Gives you broad perspectives on comparative politics.
She's very nice and incorporates a lot of real life materials for you to understand the materials!
Always gives real life, encourages critical thinking skills
Dan Chen is fantastic! Very nice, good lectures, really feel; like I am learning.
